title: BLDC
text: Three-phase brushless DC motor with trapezoidal flux distribution, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Mechanical input configuration} selects port configuration, {Simulation type} selects simulation type, {Sample time (s)} sets the sample time for discrete, {Number of pole pairs} sets the pole pairs of motor, {Stator resistance per phase (Ohm)} sets the stator resistance in each phase, {Stator d-axis inductance (H)} sets the stator inductance across, {Stator q-axis inductance (H)} sets the stator inductance across, {Permanent flux linkage constant (Wb)} sets the flux-linkage constant, {Inertia (kgm^2)} sets the rotor inertia 7.0616e-06, {Viscous damping (Nm/rad/s)} sets the viscous damping 2.6369e-06, {Static friction (Nm)}, {Initial d-axis current (A)} sets the initial current across d, {Initial q-axis current (A)} sets the initial current across q, {Initial rotor mechanical position (rad)} sets the initial mechanical position of rotor and {Initial rotor mechanical speed (rad/s)} sets the initial mechanical speed of rotor. Values come from the instance.
